-- StudyLab DATA6222: Normalisation with dependency reasoning
-- Environment: design
-- Use a disposable practice database. Load college-setup.sql for college tables.
-- CREATE examples normally run once; inspect existing objects before repeating.

Original: OrderLine(OrderID,ProductID,OrderDate,CustomerID,CustomerName,ProductName,Quantity)
Key: (OrderID,ProductID)
OrderID -> OrderDate,CustomerID
CustomerID -> CustomerName
ProductID -> ProductName
(OrderID,ProductID) -> Quantity
3NF: Customers(CustomerID PK,CustomerName)
Orders(OrderID PK,OrderDate,CustomerID FK)
Products(ProductID PK,ProductName)
OrderLines(OrderID PK/FK,ProductID PK/FK,Quantity)
